top_signals.title: Crowded Florida Race Puts Trump’s Clout to Test
top_signals.summary: Florida’s 19th Congressional District has drawn a crowded Republican field seeking to replace Byron Donalds, who is running for governor, with former Trump administration official Catalina Lauf gaining a potentially significant boost from the president’s endorsement. Bloomberg News Government Senior Reporter Greg Giroux is on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain that the race comes as affordability, insurance costs and concerns about data centers emerge as campaign issues across Florida ahead of Tuesday’s primary. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: What’s Happening in EM: Traders Get Pickier on Linkers (Podcast)
top_signals.summary: Bogota-based EM reporter Nicolle Yapur joins Leda Alvim to discuss why investors are looking beyond Brazil and Mexico for opportunities in inflation-linked bonds in the emerging world.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
